title: Loading screen
description: The predefined images the built-in loading screen cycles through while a scene's declared resources are outstanding. Compiled in, because they must reach C++ running on a console with no JSON parser. See docs/subsystems/SCENE.md.

items.description: A cooked texture asset path, relative to the resource root (e.g. "ASSETS/LOADING1.PS2A").

images.description: Shown in order, cycling back to the first once the last has shown for cycleSeconds.

cycleSeconds.description: How long each image shows before the next one, in seconds. Ignored when only one image is declared.
